verses.text: While Ezra was praying and confessing, crying and lying face down in front of God's temple, a very large crowd of Israelites gathered around him: men, women, and children. They also were crying bitterly.
Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, from the descendants of Elam, said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the peoples around us. But there is still hope for Israel.
Let's make a covenant with our God to send away all these wives and their children, as you, my master, and those who tremble at our God's commands advise. Let it be done as the law says.
Get up! This is your job, and we are with you. Be brave and do it."
So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, the Levites, and all Israel promise to do what had been said. And they promised.

Then Ezra left the front of God's temple and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. While he was there, he did not eat any food or drink any water, because he was still mourning over the unfaithfulness of the people who had returned.
An announcement was sent all through Judah and Jerusalem, telling everyone who had come back from being prisoners to gather in Jerusalem.
Anyone who did not come within three days would lose all their property, as the leaders and elders had decided, and would be shut out of the community of those who had returned.

So within three days all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered in Jerusalem. On the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people sat in the open square in front of God's temple. They were shaking because of this matter and because of the heavy rain.
Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have been unfaithful. You have married foreign women and added to Israel's guilt.
Now confess to the LORD, the God of your ancestors, and do what he wants. Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives."
The whole crowd answered with a loud voice, "You are right! We must do as you say.
But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We cannot stand outside. Besides, this cannot be done in a day or two, because so many of us have sinned in this way.

Let our leaders act for the whole community. Let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at a set time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until our God's fierce anger about this has turned away from us."
Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were against this plan, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supported them.

So the people who had returned did as they had agreed. Ezra the priest chose family leaders, one from each family, all listed by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to look into each case.
By the first day of the first month, they had finished dealing with all the men who had married foreign women.
Among the priests, these had married foreign women: from the descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
They all promised to send their wives away. Because they were guilty, each of them offered a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.
From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
From the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, also called Kelita, Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
From the rest of Israel: from the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.
From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
From the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
From the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
From the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
From the descendants of Pahath-Moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
From the descendants of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
From the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
From the descendants of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,
Bani, Binnui, Shimei,
Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
From the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.
All these men had married foreign women, and some of them had children by these wives.
